05a5bb7c: What is the name of Bleach's main protagonist?
Ichigo Kurosaki is a high schooler who can see ghosts — he receives Rukia Kuchiki's Soul Reaper powers by accident and must defend Karakura Town from Hollows.
d00e38e2: Each Soul Reaper's unique spirit sword, bound to their soul
The Zanpakutō is each Soul Reaper's unique spirit sword — bound to their soul, it has its own name and personality. Mastering it unlocks Shikai, then Bankai.
1ccf64ce: What is the name of Ichigo's Zanpakutō?
Zangetsu (“slaying moon”) is Ichigo's Zanpakutō — later revealed to be the embodiment of his Quincy power, while the “true” Zangetsu is his inner Hollow.
00c459c6: What is the first release form of a Zanpakutō called?
Shikai is the first release — the Soul Reaper calls their Zanpakutō by name to trigger its initial transformation. Bankai is the ultimate, final form.
ce9f1cce: Tensa Zangetsu is Ichigo's Bankai — the blade compresses into a thin black sword and the chain wraps around his arm. This Bankai raises his speed to an extreme, superhuman level.
a78fa385: Who is the supreme leader of the Soul Reapers?
Genryusai Shigekuni Yamamoto is the Head Captain of the 13 divisions — the oldest and most powerful Soul Reaper, founder of the Gotei 13. His Zanpakutō controls absolute fire.
f0b0e5c2: What does Ichigo summon over his face to unleash his Hollow power?
Ichigo can summon a Hollow mask that multiplies his power. He first has to learn to tame the Hollow living inside him.
775c0372: Who is Sosuke Aizen and what is his plan?
The 5th Division Captain who wants to create the King's Key
Aizen is the Captain of the 5th Division — he feigned loyalty to lead a rebellion. His plan is to create the King's Key using 100,000 souls from Karakura Town to kill the Soul King.
38c90f15: What is a Hollow in Bleach?
A human soul corrupted by despair and regret
A Soul Reaper who was killed
A Hollow is a human soul that has lost its heart through regret or despair — it wears a white mask and devours other souls to fill the hole in its chest.
a829d81f: What is Captain Byakuya Kuchiki's Zanpakutō?
Senbonzakura is Byakuya's Zanpakutō — its blade scatters into countless razor-sharp petals that can engulf the enemy in a whirlwind of tiny blades.
48185f15: What is a Hollow that gains Soul Reaper powers called?
An Arrancar is a Hollow that has removed its mask and gained Soul Reaper powers — Aizen creates them using the Hogyoku to break the barrier between Hollows and Soul Reapers.
dc4636c3: What is the name of Byakuya Kuchiki's Bankai?
Senbonzakura Kageyoshi is Byakuya's Bankai — millions of blade-petals form vast waves and then complex structures.
98482e45: Who is Uryu Ishida and what is his race?
A Quincy, from a tribe of spirit hunters
Uryu Ishida is a Quincy — a descendant of a human tribe of spirit hunters who destroy Hollows with bows of spirit energy. Quincies are the Soul Reapers' historic enemies.
bb1a9f47: A spiritual object that breaks the barrier between Soul Reaper and Hollow
A seal of the Soul King
The key to the Soul Society
The Hogyoku is an orb created separately by Aizen and Kisuke Urahara — it can break the boundary between Soul Reapers and Hollows, giving birth to Arrancars and letting Aizen evolve.
3ea1943f: What is the desert world inhabited by Hollows called?
Hueco Mundo is the world of Hollows — a white desert under an eternal black sky. At its center stands Las Noches, the fortress of Aizen and his Espada (the 10 strongest Arrancars).
36182db5: What is the name of the group of Soul Reapers with Hollow powers?
The Visored are former captains and lieutenants transformed by Aizen's experiments. Banished from the Soul Society, they wear Hollow masks.
1a95f5c6: What is Ichigo's signature technique called?
Getsuga Tensho (“moon fang heaven-piercer”) is Ichigo's signature attack — he gathers spiritual energy at the tip of his blade and fires it as an arc of energy.
b0524301: What is the Zanpakutō of the former Captain Jushiro Ukitake?
Sogyo no Kotowari, Ukitake's twin blade, absorbs enemy attacks and sends them back.
8dcb1bc8: What is the final arc of Bleach called?
The Thousand-Year Blood War (TYBW) is Bleach's final arc — the Quincy of the Wandenreich empire, led by Yhwach, declare war on the Soul Society in an epic battle for control of the spirit world.
93579562: The Soul King's son and leader of the Wandenreich Quincy
Yhwach is the son of the Soul King and the father of all Quincy — he shared fragments of his soul with humans over the ages. His power, “The Almighty”, lets him see and change every future.
d7c15122: How does Ichigo lose his powers the first time?
By using the Final Getsuga Tensho (Mugetsu)
By crossing into the Soul Society
Ichigo uses Mugetsu (the Final Getsuga Tensho) against Aizen — he pours all his power into one attack, briefly becoming Getsuga itself, at the cost of all his Soul Reaper powers.
ce4327f5: Which character is the mysterious mentor who guides Ichigo?
Kisuke Urahara, a former 12th Division captain exiled from the Soul Society, runs a small shop in Karakura. He trains Ichigo before his departure for the Soul Society.
051c1346: Hihio Zabimaru is Renji's Bankai — a huge segmented snake-like skeleton formed from his Shikai's sections. His true form, revealed during the TYBW, is even more powerful.
604dfb02: Who is the Soul King protected by the Soul Society?
An entity sealed in the Royal Palace
The Soul King is a mysterious entity sealed in the Royal Palace — the linchpin holding the worlds together. Yhwach seeks to kill him and absorb the spiritual power of the world.
aeab7ec3: What is the pressure of a very powerful Soul Reaper's spiritual energy called?
Reiatsu is the pressure exerted by a being's spiritual energy (Reiryoku) — very powerful Soul Reapers can paralyze or crush weaker opponents simply by releasing their Reiatsu.
5b1ade87: How does Ichigo get his powers back after losing them?
Through Fullbring and an energy transfer from the Soul Reapers
He never gets them back in the series
Ichigo develops Fullbring (a human power linked to Hollows) — then the Soul Reapers collectively give him their own energy to restore his powers, stronger than before.
81f91520: What is Kenpachi Zaraki's Zanpakutō and what is special about it?
Nozarashi, whose name he only learns very late
Kenpachi fought for centuries without knowing his sword's name. During the Thousand-Year Blood War, he finally hears its name, Nozarashi, and unleashes his Shikai and then his Bankai.
29cf9202: How can Ichigo see spirits when he is human at the start?
He was born a Soul Reaper
He has an abnormally high innate spiritual sensitivity
Ichigo has extremely high innate spiritual sensitivity — later revealed to come from his hybrid nature (a Soul Reaper father and a pure-blooded Quincy mother). This mix of powers makes him unique.
ad385fd4: What is the name of the underground prison holding the Soul Society's worst criminals?
Muken is the deepest level of the Soul Society's underground prison. Aizen is sentenced to 20,000 years of imprisonment there.
edf244d2: Who is Orihime Inoue and what is her unique ability?
A human whose Shun Shun Rikka hairpins can reject reality
Orihime is a human with the Shun Shun Rikka — six spirits in her hairpins that can reject reality itself. She can heal fatal wounds and undo attacks as if they never happened.
1b9f08a1: What is Zangetsu's final form revealed in the TYBW?
After discovering his origins, Ichigo has his sword reforged: he gets two blades, a large one and a small one, reflecting his dual nature.
8e45b153: What is the world where souls go after death in Bleach called?
The Soul Society is the world where the souls of the dead go after purification — divided into the Seireitei (home of the Soul Reapers) and the Rukongai (districts where most souls live).
9dbe42c8: Which captain is known for his cold intelligence and an ice Bankai?
Toshiro Hitsugaya is the gifted Captain of the 10th Division and the youngest captain — his Zanpakutō Hyorinmaru controls ice and water. His Bankai, Daiguren Hyorinmaru, forms imposing ice armor.
4c5f98ae: What is the link between Sosuke Aizen and Kisuke Urahara in the creation of the Hogyoku?
Each created his own, then Aizen merged the two
Urahara and Aizen each created a Hogyoku. Urahara had hidden his inside Rukia's soul; Aizen rips it out of her and merges it with his own.
845fb33c: How does Kisuke Urahara finally trap Aizen?
With a seal hidden in his attacks that activates when Aizen weakens
During their fight, Urahara plants a seal in Aizen's body. When Aizen is weakened by Ichigo, the seal activates and immobilizes him.
777bafa4: Who is Chad (Yasutora Sado) and what is his ability?
A human with spirit-energy arms that keep growing stronger

Chad is Ichigo's best human friend — his right arm, Brazo Derecha de Gigante, is a defensive shield, and his left arm, Brazo Izquierda del Diablo, a powerful attack. His abilities are linked to Hollows.
c81ead0f: What is special about Gin Ichimaru's Bankai?
Its blade can extend up to 13 km
Kamishini no Yari, Gin's Bankai, extends up to 13 kilometers at lightning speed. Gin also hides a poison able to destroy cells.
431a5350: Which numbered Kidō spell is one of the most powerful offensive spells in Bleach?

Hado #90 Kurohitsugi (Black Coffin) is among the most powerful offensive spells — it traps the target in a black coffin pierced by spears of gravity. Aizen uses it to show off his power when he reveals himself.
3efcb5f0: What are each Espada's personal subordinates called?
The Fracción are an Espada's dedicated servants. They are distinct from the Números, the lower-ranked Arrancars.
45f72f1c: Who succeeds Yamamoto as Head Captain after his death?
Shunsui Kyoraku (Captain of the 8th, then 1st Division) becomes the new Head Captain after Yamamoto's death during the TYBW — his carefree style hides exceptional power and wisdom.
fd5c52e8: What is the effect of the Quincy technique Vollständig?
The Quincy's ultimate form, creating a golden aura of wings

Vollständig is the Quincy equivalent of Bankai — it creates an aura of wings of light around the Quincy, boosting their power to the extreme. Unlike Bankai, which the Quincy can steal, Vollständig cannot be stolen.
503477ef: Who is revealed to be Ichigo's father, and what was his past role?
Isshin Shiba — former Captain of the 10th Division

Isshin Kurosaki (born Isshin Shiba) is revealed to be a former Captain of the 10th Division — he lost his powers protecting Masaki (Ichigo's mother, a Quincy). Their love story explains Ichigo's hybrid nature.
ba5f8e54: What are the Quincy's Blut Vene and Blut Arterie?
Their passive, blood-based defensive and offensive abilities
Blut Vene strengthens defense by running spirit energy through the veins, while Blut Arterie strengthens attack. A Quincy cannot use both at once.
3091ad0b: How does Aizen evade every attack at first thanks to his Zanpakutō?
Kyoka Suigetsu creates a perfect illusion affecting every sense
Kyoka Suigetsu creates a perfect illusion affecting all five senses — anyone who has seen the blade released once is permanently under its spell. Aizen can fake his death or swap places at will.
a5a3f1fb: What is the secret reason the Soul Society wiped out the Quincy 200 years ago?
Their destruction of Hollows unbalanced the cycle of souls between worlds
They wanted to invade the Soul Society
Quincies destroy Hollows' souls — this stops those souls from returning to the natural cycle, creating an imbalance that threatens the existence of both the spirit and human worlds in the long run.
ba627ec3: What is the Arrancar equivalent of Bankai in Bleach?
Resurrección is an Arrancar's sword release — it reveals their true Hollow form and multiplies their power. Some Espada, like Ulquiorra, even have a Resurrección: Segunda Etapa.
8e1b78b1: What is the flash step technique of Hollows and Arrancars called?
Sonído is the Hollow and Arrancar equivalent of Shunpo (Soul Reapers) — ultra-fast movement. Hirenkyaku is the Quincy version and Bringer Light the Fullbringers'.
2187b9cf: Which 11th Division captain lives only for combat?
Kenpachi Zaraki loves fighting. He wears an eyepatch that drains his spiritual energy to make fights longer and more fun.
ac94fb84: What is the Bankai of Toshiro Hitsugaya, the youngest captain in history?
Daiguren Hyorinmaru is Hitsugaya's Bankai — ice armor with dragon wings and an icy tail. He controls ice and temperature on a colossal scale, freezing everything around him.
e236d5e8: What is the Soul Reapers' ultra-fast movement technique called?
Shunpo (Flash Step) lets Soul Reapers move so fast they seem to vanish. Yoruichi is its great master.
e98298e8: Which captain controls absolute flames with his Ryujin Jakka?

Genryusai Shigekuni Yamamoto wields Ryujin Jakka (“Flowing Blade Like a Fire Dragon”) — considered the most powerful fire Zanpakutō in the Soul Society's history. Even his Shikai generates devastating heat.
ff085fe4: Which Arrancar is the 4th Espada and has a regeneration power?
Ulquiorra Cifer is the 4th Espada. He regenerates almost instantly, and his Resurrección, Murciélago, has a second stage unique among the Espada.
7522d8d3: What is Kugo Ginjo's Fullbring in the Fullbring arc?

Cross of Scaffold is Kugo Ginjo's Fullbring — it turns his cross pendant into a huge sword. A former substitute Soul Reaper who felt betrayed by the Soul Society, he manipulates Ichigo to steal his restored powers.
d326235a: Who is the final enemy of Bleach's Thousand-Year Blood War arc?

Yhwach is the final enemy of the TYBW — son of the Soul King and father of all Quincy. His power, “The Almighty”, lets him see every possible future and change it. He is finally defeated thanks to Ichigo and Aizen.
